subject: general
question: What is the name of the consumer awareness programme started by the Department of Consumer Affairs in 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Consumer Empowerment Week**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Consumer Empowerment Week** was initiated by the **Department of Consumer Affairs in 2022.**
 
• The program aims to **raise awareness among consumers** about their rights and responsibilities.
 
• It includes various activities and campaigns to educate consumers on how to make informed decisions and seek redressal for grievances.
 
• The initiative also focuses on promoting digital literacy and safe online transactions among consumers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Department of Consumer Affairs operates under the Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution.
 
• The objective of the department is to **protect the rights of consumers** and ensure fair trade practices.
 
• Various consumer helplines and portals have been set up to assist consumers in lodging complaints and seeking resolution.
 
• The department also collaborates with state governments and other stakeholders to implement consumer protection laws effectively.
